Name: Kanazawa Station
Notes: Arrive Nov 4 from Takayama (bus or train). Hokuriku Shinkansen to Tokyo Nov 7

Name: Kenrokuen Garden
Notes: One of Japan's three great gardens. Best early morning. Yukitsuri rope-work should be up by Nov 6-7

Name: Kanazawa Castle Park
Location: Kanazawa Castle Park, Kanazawa, Ishikawa, Japan
Notes: Next to Kenrokuen. Free to walk the grounds

Name: 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art
Location: 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art, Kanazawa, Ishikawa, Japan
Notes: Next to Kenrokuen. Swimming Pool installation

Name: Higashi Chaya District
Location: Higashi Chaya District, Kanazawa, Ishikawa, Japan
Notes: Geisha teahouse district. Tea houses and gold-leaf shops

Name: Nagamachi Samurai District
Location: Nagamachi Samurai District, Kanazawa, Ishikawa, Japan
Notes: Preserved samurai residences and earthen walls. Near Korinbo

Name: Omicho Market
Notes: Kaisendon (seafood rice bowls). Snow crab season opens Nov 6

Name: Korinbo Tree Fantasy Illumination
Notes: About 110000 LEDs on the zelkova trees. 5 PM to midnight. Free. Runs the whole stay

Name: Sushi Kibatani
Notes: 1 star. Dinner only. About 30000-40000 yen. 8-seat counter near Higashi Chaya. Check the pin location

Name: Otome Sushi
Notes: 2 stars. About 23000 yen dinner. Status unclear so call to confirm before counting on it. Check the pin location

Name: Lodging area - Korinbo / Katamachi
Notes: Recommended base. Central to Kenrokuen and Nagamachi and Omicho. Nov 4-7. Need a room for 3 from Nov 5
